two-men.name: Two Men
two-men.question: I'm caught between two men and I don't know which one is right for me
two-men.shape: Two men need one card each before anything can be weighed. Then what put her between them, what the waiting pays, which one she is already living as though she chose, what the other costs to keep, and what ends it.

positions.name: The one you'd name first
positions.job: What the first of them is actually offering, measured in what he does. Not what he has said he will do

positions.name: The other one
positions.job: What the second man is actually offering, in what he does. What he gives her that the first one does not

positions.name: What was true before either of them
positions.job: What was already true before either man arrived. The thing that made room for a second one in the first place

positions.name: What having two of them saves you
positions.job: What staying between them spares her. What she does not have to find out while there are still two

positions.name: The one you've already chosen
positions.job: Which one she has already chosen with her time, whatever she says when asked. The evidence, not the answer she gives

positions.name: What keeping the other one costs
positions.job: What holding the second one in reserve takes out of her, and what it takes out of him

positions.name: What ends it
positions.job: The one thing that closes the question, and which of the two conversations she has been avoiding longer

the-thing-you-keep-seeing.name: The Thing You Keep Seeing
the-thing-you-keep-seeing.question: I keep seeing the same thing over and over. What is it trying to tell me?
the-thing-you-keep-seeing.shape: The repeat itself first, then the week it started, the hour it shows up, what it is standing in front of, what she would lose if it stopped, what the watching has cost, and what settles it.

positions.name: What keeps arriving
positions.job: The plain shape of the thing that keeps turning up, and how long it has been doing it

positions.name: The week you started looking
positions.job: What changed in her life the same week the repeats began. Not the first one she saw — the first one she counted

positions.name: When it shows up
positions.job: The pattern in the timing. What she is doing, or about to do, in the hour before each one arrives

positions.name: What it's holding a place for
positions.job: The person or the decision the repeat keeps a place open for. Not what the sign means — what it stands in front of

positions.name: What you'd lose if it stopped
positions.job: What she would miss the week they stopped coming. What the watching gives her that nothing else does

positions.name: What waiting on the next one has taken
positions.job: What the watching has already cost her. The thing she has put off until the next one arrives

positions.name: What settles it
positions.job: The one thing that would settle what the repeat has been marking. Not another sign — an act she takes

everything-i-have-goes-to-other-people.name: Everything I Have Goes To Other People
everything-i-have-goes-to-other-people.question: I give everything to everybody. Why does none of it come back to me?
everything-i-have-goes-to-other-people.shape: Where it goes, which of them never asked for it, the year she became the one who copes, what that still pays her, what five more years of it takes for good, and the one thing she stops doing.

positions.name: Where it all goes
positions.job: Where her week actually goes, hour by hour. Not the person she would name first — the one that takes most

positions.name: The one who never asked
positions.job: Which of them took it without ever asking, and which one she handed over before she was asked

positions.name: The year you became the one who copes
positions.job: The year she became the one who copes, and what was happening in the house that year

positions.name: What being needed pays you
positions.job: What being the one they all come to still pays her. The standing she would lose if she stopped

positions.name: What five more years of it takes
positions.job: What another five years of it takes for good. The thing that stops being possible, not the thing that gets harder

positions.name: The thing you stop doing
positions.job: The one thing she stops doing for somebody else, and what it costs her when they notice

the-years-with-no-title.name: The Years With No Title
the-years-with-no-title.question: We've been together years and it still has no name. Where do I actually stand?
the-years-with-no-title.shape: The years as they actually are, then the line she has never been over, what the missing word keeps for him, the day she stopped asking, what a name would take from her, and the asking.

positions.name: What you actually have
positions.job: What the years have actually contained. The plain inventory, before the missing word is counted

positions.name: Where the line is
positions.job: Which parts of his life she has been inside and which she has never once been in. The boundary, drawn from facts

positions.name: What the missing word keeps for him
positions.job: What he keeps by never naming it, and what naming it would take away from him

positions.name: The day you stopped asking
positions.job: The last time she raised it, what happened, and what she decided about asking again

positions.name: What a name would take from you
positions.job: What she would lose the day it became definite. What staying unnamed has been protecting her from hearing

positions.name: What asking once costs
positions.job: The one plain question that ends the not-knowing, and what she is agreeing to hear when she asks it

the-honest-answer-not-the-one-you-want.name: The Honest Answer, Not The One You Want
the-honest-answer-not-the-one-you-want.question: Give it to me straight — what is everybody being too nice to tell me?
the-honest-answer-not-the-one-you-want.shape: What she already knows, then the sentence nobody says, why they stopped saying it, what the soft version has been paying her, what being spared it has cost her, and what is different once it is said.

positions.name: What you already know
positions.job: What she has already worked out and keeps asking about anyway. Not what she fears — what she has quietly concluded

positions.name: The sentence nobody will say to you
positions.job: The one sentence the people around her have stopped saying out loud. Not the soft version they use instead

positions.name: Why they stopped saying it
positions.job: What happened the last time somebody told her, and what it taught everybody around her to do instead

positions.name: What the kind version has been paying you
positions.job: What the softened version has been buying her. What she would have had to do the day somebody said it plainly

positions.name: What it has cost you to be spared it
positions.job: What being handled gently has already taken from her. The part she has been blaming herself for that was never hers

positions.name: What you do with it once it's said
positions.job: The first thing that is different once the sentence is out. One act, not a decision she can keep turning over

how-long-can-this-go-on.name: How Long Can This Go On
how-long-can-this-go-on.question: How long can this actually go on?
how-long-can-this-go-on.shape: The arrangement in its own numbers, the half that has never moved, what one contact does to the question, what this size costs him, what it has already cost her, and the one thing that would have to change.

positions.name: What it actually is, in numbers
positions.job: The arrangement as it stands, counted. How often, how long, and what is in the gaps

positions.name: The half that has never moved
positions.job: Which side of it has not changed in all this time, and which side keeps her reading it as movement

positions.name: What each visit buys
positions.job: What one contact does to the question she was about to ask. What she counts as progress that changes nothing

positions.name: What this size costs him
positions.job: What he keeps by leaving it exactly this size, and what he would have to give up to change it

positions.name: What the years have taken
positions.job: What she has spent on it that she cannot get back. Not the tiredness — the thing she stopped doing

positions.name: What would have to change
positions.job: The one thing that would have to become inconvenient for it to stop holding. Not a length of time — a change
